title: herniaria ciliolata subsp. subciliata
intro: Herniaria ciliolata subsp. subciliata, commonly known as Alpine Rupturewort, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, as well as its ability to soothe digestive issues and alleviate symptoms of respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Herniaria ciliolata subsp. subciliata include its expectorant and anti-spasmodic effects, which can help relieve coughs and calm muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
